Income Tax Portal Guides Taxpayers in Selecting Correct ITR Form

India's Income Tax e-filing portal has introduced a step-by-step tool to assist taxpayers in choosing the appropriate Income Tax Return (ITR) form. This feature aims to simplify the filing process and reduce errors for individuals navigating the complexities of tax submission. The portal's guidance is designed to help taxpayers identify the correct form based on their specific financial circumstances.
